Excel formulas resulted in #N/A errors across all target cells because the INDEX/MATCH logic failed to locate series codes and years in the Data sheet.
The test_lookup_blocks failed when cell H12 returned #N/A instead of the expected 302.5, cascading into downstream failures in test_derived_values_and_stats. The mediator report suggests a mismatch between series codes in Task!D:D and the Data sheet, potentially due to trailing spaces or incorrect header matching in row 10. The planner must re-verify the Data sheet structure and ensure absolute/relative references in the INDEX/MATCH/MATCH formula correctly align with the source dimensions.
